artworks.title: Imatiens glanduligera
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a branch with bifurcating twigs, showcasing the central vertical stem and symmetrical horizontal curves on each side. The color scheme is monochromatic in shades of gray, creating a high-contrast black-and-white look. The central stem runs vertically through the center, with curved branches extending outward towards the edges of the frame.

artworks.title: a Cornus Nuttallii; b Cornus officinalis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two photographs of plant stems with buds. The color palette consists of grayscale tones. The top photograph features a stem with a bud on the left side, traveling horizontally from left to right. The lower photograph shows a similar stem with a bud, oriented horizontally from left to right. Both are against a plain background highlighting the texture and form of the plant material.

artworks.title: Picea excelsa
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows two black and white photographs of plant stems. The left stem has a thicker base that tapers to a narrow rough surface at the top, while the right stem has a wider, flatter top with a textured surface. Both stems are vertically positioned centrally on a light background.

artworks.title: Acer rufinerve
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up of a plant stem with two large, open pods positioned symmetrically on either side of the stem. These pods reveal round seeds inside. The photograph is in black and white, with various shades of gray giving depth and texture to the objects. The stem runs vertically through the center of the image, while the pods are attached slightly above its middle, curving outward and then upwards. The seeds are clustered closely within the pods, remaining predominantly dark against the lighter fibers that surround them.

artworks.title: Primula japonica
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a plant stem with several rounded buds or seed pods clustered at the top. The grayscale color palette gives the photograph a range of tones from black to white. In the center, the vertical main stem divides into multiple smaller stems, each ending in a pod that spreads out symmetrically, occupying the upper half of the frame. The detailed texture of the stems and pods are prominent against the light background. The image is framed with a border, and the number "23" is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Physostegia virginiana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a plant stem with several large, pointed leaves. The color palette is grayscale, with shades of black, white, and gray. The stem runs vertically from the top to the bottom, with leaves extending outward from either side in a symmetrical composition.

artworks.title: Aristolochia clematitis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a plant stem with elongated and curved leaves or petals. The color palette is grayscale, highlighting shadows and texture. The stem is centered in the image with symmetrical leaves spreading out. The number 25 is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Cucurbita
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three elongated, curved shapes with textured surfaces twisting and turning in an abstract manner. These forms resemble sinuous curves. They stand out against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Cajophora lateritia, Loasaceae
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three large, spiral-shaped objects arranged vertically in a row. The objects have pointed ends at the bottom and are colored in various shades of black, gray, and white. They are centered within the frame, evenly spaced from left to right, while the background is a light gray color.

artworks.title: a u. c Cassiope tetragona; b Chrysanthemum Leucanthemum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image contains two braided patterns at the top and bottom, along with a large segmented form in the center resembling a plant or vegetable. The image is in black, white, and gray. The braided patterns span horizontally across the top and bottom, while the segmented form with a curved stalk is centrally positioned, slightly tilted on the right. The number "28" is visible in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Thujopsis dolabrata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows three large, vertically oriented objects with a detailed, textured surface in various shades of grey. The objects are arranged side by side, with the tallest and widest object in the center, and two slightly smaller objects on either side. Numbers in the bottom right corner suggest it is a page from a book.

artworks.title: Saxifraga aizoon
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large succulent plant with layers of thick, fleshy leaves arranged in a circular rosette pattern. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of gray and black, highlighting the texture and details of the plant. The succulent is centrally positioned on the page, against a lighter gray background that contrasts with the darker tones of the plant.

artworks.title: Aconiyum anthora
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large, intricately detailed leaf with a long, slender stem at the bottom, fanning out into multiple pointed segments with textured surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of shades of gray and black. The leaf is positioned centrally with the stem extending downward towards the bottom edge of the image, while the segmented ends of the leaf stretch outward, filling the upper part of the composition.

artworks.title: Eryngium Bourgatii
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture in the image shows an abstract form resembling a stylized tree. Its branches are spread out in a symmetrical, radial pattern, each branch tapering to sharp points. The material appears to be metal with a smooth surface texture and a consistent shading of gray. The sculpture maintains a vertical orientation with a narrow trunk supporting the branching upper section, suggesting a balanced and centrally organized form. The image is printed with the number "32" at the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: a Polypodiaceae Aspidieae; b Vaccinium corymbosum; c Polystichum falcatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of decorative botanical motifs. The image displays three different botanical designs or carvings. In the top and bottom sections, there are stylized spiraling formations with intricate leaf patterns. The central section showcases a cluster of rounded, pod-like forms resembling unopened buds or ornamental seed pods, branching outward. Each element is detailed, emphasizing texture and form.

artworks.title: a Polypodium vulgare; b Ribes nigrum; c Pteridium aquilinum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of ornate metallic or botanical forms. It shows three separate panels with different wrought iron or intricately detailed organic-like shapes. The top panel has a curled loop. The central panel is adorned with small, bell-shaped flowers on slender stems. The bottom panel features a loop with textured details, resembling a tendril or vine design. All elements exhibit a high level of craftsmanship and detail, reflecting an interplay of strong, yet delicate forms reminiscent of nature.

artworks.title: Saxifraga Willkommniana
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The sculpture in the image is an abstract form resembling a tree with multiple branches extending outwards like a fan. The material appears to be a dark, metallic substance, likely metal or bronze, highlighted with a rough texture that gives an earthy quality to its surface. The sculpture's color is a deep, dark gray or black, with subtle variations and reflections. In relation to humans, the sculpture stands upright with a sturdy base and branches extending outwards, suggesting a moderate size when scaled to human dimensions.

artworks.title: Scolopendrium vulgare
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features two large folded leaves with one slightly turned to the left and the other more upright and to the right. The color palette consists of various shades of gray, black, and white, highlighting the textures and details of the leaves. The leaf on the left is positioned towards the left side of the image and curls at the top, while the leaf on the right stands taller and slightly curls at the top edge.

artworks.title: Achillea umbellata
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an abstract form resembling a stylized tree or plant. The image depicts a dark, textured shape that branches out from a central trunk-like form, with several irregularly shaped lobes extending outward. The photograph is monochromatic, providing a stark contrast between the dark form and the lighter background. The branches and lobes are bold with a rugged, rough surface. The image has a graphic quality, emphasizing the abstract nature of the subject and offering an interesting interplay of shapes and textures.

artworks.title: Poltstichum munitum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a spiraling fern frond in black and white. The fern frond is in a vertical orientation with a curling tip at the top right and the main stalk extending downward to the bottom left. The image is bordered by a slightly off-white page with the number "38" in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Verbena canadensis
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image features a botanical specimen resembling a branch with multiple smaller stems and pointed leaves extending from it. It is captured in monochromatic grayscale. The branch occupies the central area of the image, arcing slightly from the bottom left to the upper right. Its textured surface is contrasted against a smoother background.

artworks.title: Silphium laciniatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: This is a photograph of two curled, leaf-like objects against a neutral background. The objects have rough textures and undulating curves, with shadows and highlights emphasizing their forms.

artworks.title: Silphium laciniatum
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large plant stem with curled leaf-like structures extending from it. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring shades of gray. The plant stem is positioned centrally within the image, with its elongated structure reaching upwards and the curled elements spreading outwards in different directions.

artworks.title: Trollius europaeus
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mary and Dan Solomon and Patrons' Permanent Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a circular arrangement of petal-like shapes radiating outward with layered textures. The shapes are curling into themselves, creating a visually intriguing effect.
